title: Add a DELETE endpoint to a TypeScript Express-like server
description: A simple Node.js HTTP server (no framework) handles GET and POST for a TODO list. It's missing the DELETE /todos/:id endpoint. Add it so the integration test passes. Exercises backend_feature category and TypeScript editing.

task_spec.prompt:
Add a DELETE /todos/:id endpoint to server.ts. When called:
- If the todo with that id exists: remove it from the array and respond with HTTP 204 (no body)
- If not found: respond with HTTP 404 and `{"error": "not found"}`

The existing GET and POST handlers show the pattern. The test suite in server.test.ts has 2 DELETE tests that currently fail.

Run `npx jest --no-coverage` to verify all 4 tests pass.
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `npm install --silent && npx jest --no-coverage 2>&1` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.
